summary: Phase 2 end-to-end testing (Metrics, AI Sales Coach, AI Ad Creator, Client Portal & Reports). 9 new pytest cases added to backend_test.py — all 9 pass (100%). Full frontend E2E via Playwright on the demo TEST_E2E_HVAC client passed every step: metrics editor computes CPL=$40 (1000/25) after save, /api/dashboard aggregates ad_spend ($1,200) and leads_generated (30) into the stat cards, Ad Creator generates a Claude campaign card with hooks/headlines/CTA, Sales Coach prep-result renders, Sales Coach score-run returns a numeric score + closing_probability, Reports tab generates a report row and clicking View opens /portal/<share_token> which renders the branded report headline + narrative WITHOUT any auth token in a fresh browser page. Public portal 404s on invalid token; all new auth-protected endpoints correctly return 401 without a Bearer token.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 884 lines — past the 700-line threshold. Split into routers (auth, clients, ai, docs, sales, ads, reports, portal) before adding Meta/Higgsfield code.

MetricsUpdate.leads is Optional[int]=0 but line 651 does `spend/leads` — the truthiness guard prevents ZeroDivisionError today, but if leads is ever passed as None from a partial payload the current expression `m['leads']` in the divisor would still work only because of the guard; keep the guard when refactoring.
share_token uses uuid4().hex (128-bit) which is unguessable, good. Consider adding a DB unique index on reports.share_token to guarantee uniqueness and speed up the public portal lookup.

Ad campaign `session_id=f"ads-{client_id}"` is reused across all generations for a client — Claude history in emergentintegrations will keep growing per client. Consider per-generation session_ids or explicit history truncation.
Public /api/portal/{share_token} has no rate limiting — trivial to brute-force scan tokens (although 128-bit space makes it impractical). Add basic per-IP throttling before wide sharing.
SalesScoreRequest.transcript truncated to 12000 chars silently — add a client-side length warning or explicit 413 response when transcript is longer.
startup uses deprecated @app.on_event (also flagged last iteration) — migrate to lifespan handler.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (metrics editor, Ad Creator, Sales Coach prep & score, Reports + public portal, dashboard aggregates)

seed_data_creation: Test run left one report on TEST_E2E_HVAC (share_token can be viewed at /portal/<token> — visible on Reports tab). Backend pytest created & cleaned up its own TEST_Phase2Co client.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 is fully functional. Pytest must be run with `-n 0` to avoid xdist read-timeouts on the preview backend when AI endpoints run in parallel (or leave the default -n 2 but expect occasional 15s read timeouts). Full command: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0`. Demo client id ed236514-80b5-4314-8f42-b5005dd733e2 (TEST_E2E_HVAC) has metrics + at least one ad campaign + report saved. Public portal path is /portal/<share_token>. Meta Ads sync + Higgsfield video are NOT implemented yet (per user note).
